name: mountain
title: SEGA Rally Championship (1995) - Mountain

start_grid.note: 4 cars x (x, y, z) f32; table order in ROM = Desert, Forest, Mountain, Lake Side

props_note: every track needs its pobj files + grass cache: without them the grass set-up (0x506FD0) never runs and the game dies at 0x5DE16C when a wheel touches the road (in-game runs 2026-10-07). 'minimal' is not usable.
road_layers_note: Alpine4's Terrain_Tarmac pair: clean tarmac (Desert4's own Safari tarmac throws dust clouds)
mirror_groups_note: the castle (three boards, one folded screen) shows its picture mirrored as a whole, in place: it is painted lit from the left, the 1995 sun is to its right
round_exclude_note: the village's roof tile (labelled 'dirt'): never rounded
light_dir_note: the 1995 ROM's light vector (0, -0.94, 0.34): sun 70 degrees up, to the right of the start grid. Settled by the user on 2026-10-08 ("let's keep the 70deg sun") after an A/B against a 16:30 sun (47.7 degrees). The earlier default [-4, -6, 4] (47 degrees) was a guess from before the ROM vector was found.
